citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 10:14 AM on
August, 14, 2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee and their facility representative by phone and text
message. A facility representative responded at 10:18 AM that no one was available to accompany the APHIS official.
Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations.
Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
